verdict.rationale: A public API is a fair question for an HR/payroll SaaS like Justworks, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only UI-driven workflows (e.g., clicking Pay > Make a Payment) and a first-party Xero accounting integration, which are adjacent features rather than a documented public API for users. The help-center URLs belong to the host knowledge-base platform, not to a Justworks product API, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
